description: Source code implementing a WorkerThread system for ANGLE, including thread pool management, waitable events, and asynchronous task handling.

classes.name: WaitableEvent
classes.description: Base class for waitable synchronization events.

classes.name: WaitableEventDone
classes.description: Derived class representing a completed waitable event.

classes.name: SingleThreadedWorkerPool
classes.description: Worker pool implementation for single-threaded execution.

classes.name: AsyncWaitableEvent
classes.description: Waitable event for asynchronous task execution, supporting futures.

classes.name: AsyncWorkerPool
classes.description: Worker pool implementation for multi-threaded asynchronous execution.

methods.name: WaitableEvent::wait
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled.

methods.name: WaitableEventDone::isReady
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating event is ready.

methods.name: SingleThreadedWaitableEvent::isReady
methods.description: Returns true, indicating event is always ready.

methods.name: SingleThreadedWorkerPool::postWorkerTask
methods.description: Executes the task immediately and returns a waitable event.

methods.name: AsyncWaitableEvent::setFuture
methods.description: Associates a future with the waitable event.

methods.name: AsyncWaitableEvent::wait
methods.description: Waits for the future to complete.

methods.name: AsyncWaitableEvent::isReady
methods.description: Checks if the future is ready.

methods.name: AsyncWorkerPool::postWorkerTask
methods.description: Queues a task for asynchronous execution and returns a waitable event.

methods.name: AsyncWorkerPool::setMaxThreads
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of worker threads.

methods.name: AsyncWorkerPool::checkToRunPendingTasks
methods.description: Dispatches pending tasks if thread slots are available.

methods.name: WorkerThreadPool::Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a thread pool, either async or single-threaded.

methods.name: WorkerThreadPool::PostWorkerTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the specified worker thread pool.
